s: Dine hasibba ved' kosot ubo l"a seipim: yihyeh shulchano aruk mibbeod yom, kede lehatchil hasseder miyyad keshettecheshak. Veap im hu bebet hammidrash — yaqum miyyad keshettecheshak, shemmitzva lemaher lehatchil hasseder bishbil hattinoqot shello yishnu, vehattora omra: "vehiggadta lebinka bayyom hahu":

Umikkol maqom, lo yemaher lehatchil haqqiddush qodem sheyyihyeh vadday chasheka. Ap al pi shebbishar yamim tobim yakol haadam lehosip mechol al haqqodesh leqaddesh veleekol mibbeod yom, mikkol maqom bepesach eno yakol laasot ken, lepi sheakilat matztza huqesha laakilat pesach, shenneemar "al matztzot umerorim yokluhu", ubepesach neemar: "veakelu et habbasar ballayla hazzeh", ballayla mammash, vekevan sheakilat matztza shehi min hattora eno ella ballayla, laken gam kol haarba kosot shettiqqenu chakamim eno ella ballayla, bazzeman harauy laakilat matztza, shekkol mah shettiqqenu chakamim keen shel tora tiqqenu, vekos shel qiddush hu echad min haarba kosot, lepikak tzarik ballayla mammash, velo bemah shehosip mechol al haqqodesh:

Mi shehu abel apillu al abiv veimmo — chayyab lehaseb, veeno rashshay limnoa millehaseb mechamat haabelut, shehare mishsheaberu shiba rashshay lehaseb al mittato apillu bechol, sheeno chayyab bikpiyyat hammitta ella tok shiba. Vaapillu niqbar meto beereb pesach, mikkol maqom miyyad shehiggia happesach — botla mimmennu haabelut shiba im nahag abelut shaa achat qodem hallayla, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman shtz"t:

Abal im lo nahag abelut kelal qodem happesach beinyan sheadayin lo botla mammash abelut shiba — nohagin shello lehaseb belel pesach, lepi shechoshebin hasibba zo kidbarim shebbetzina shehu noheg otam baregel, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea sham. Umikkol maqom, yakol lilbosh haqqitel shellobeshin bishat asiyyat hasseder, shebbeged zeh hu beged metim, velobeshin oto lehaknia halleb, shello tazuach dato mechamat hassimcha vehacherut sheosin belel zeh:
Vechayyab haabel behallel shebbelayla zeh. Ap sheen nohagin liqrot hallel bebet haabel, mikkol maqom hallel zeh choba hu:

Ap al pi shebbekol hashshana tob lemaet bekelim naim zeker lachurban, mikkol maqom belel pesach tob leharbot bekelim naim kepi kocho, apillu hakkelim sheen tzarik lasseuda yesadderem yapeh al hashshulchan lenoy, zeker lecherut. Vaapillu kelim hamemushkanim beyado min hannokri yesadderem al hashshulchan lenoy. Veap im yirtzeh lehishtammesh bahem — en bazeh mishshum gezel hannokri velo mishshum genebat daat, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"k:

Veyakin meqom moshabo, sheyyesheb bahasibba derek cherut, kederek shehamlakim vehaggedolim okelim, lepi shebbekol dor vador chayyab haadam leharot et atzmo keillu hu atta yotze mishshibud mitzrayim, shenneemar "baabur zeh asa Hashem li betzeti mimmitzrayim", veal dabar zeh tzivva haqqadosh baruk hu: "vezakarta ki ebed hayita bemitzrayim", keillu atta beatzmeka hayita bemitzrayim ebed venipdeta veyatzata lecherut, lepikak tzarik laasot kol maaseh layla zeh derek cherut, kemo shennitbaer:

Veani sheen lo karim ukesatot lehaseb alehen, mikkol maqom yesheb al hassapsal velo al haqqarqa kebishar yemot hashshana. Veim epshar lo lismok al yerek shel chabero — hare zo niqret hasibba. Abal lo yismok al yerek atzmo, mippene shennireh kedoeg, veen zo derek cherut:

Ukeshehu meseb — lo yatteh al gabbo velo al panayv, sheen zeh derek cherut, ella yatteh al tziddo hassemalit, velo al haymanit sheen derek hasibba bekak, shehare tzarik leekol beyamin. Veod sheim yaseb beyamin yukal labo lide sakkana, lepi shehavveshet hu beyamin vehaqqaneh bismol, veim yatteh al yemino — yihyeh havveshet millematta veqaneh milmala, vihe niptach hakkoba sheal pi haqqaneh meelayv veyikkanes hammaakal derek haqqaneh veyabo lide sakkana. Ulepikak, ap mi shehu itter sheddarko leekol bismol, ap al pi ken yaseb al semolo shehu semol kol adam:

Ishsha, ben nesua ben almana ugerusha — enah tzerika hasibba, lepi sheen derek hannashim lehaseb veen zeh derek cherut lahen. Veim hi chashuba vedarkah lehaseb — tzerika hasibba. Vekol hannashim shellanu niqraot chashubot, veap al pi ken lo nahagu lehaseb, lepi sheyyesh omerim shebbizman hazzeh en tzarik lehaseb kelal, kevan sheap bishar yemot hashshana en regilut lehaseb kelal baaratzot hallalu, ella ap hamlakim vehaggedolim yoshebin kedarkan, veal dibrehen somekot hannashim akshav shello lehaseb:

Ben haokel etzel abiv — tzarik hasibba, apillu im abiv hu rabbo mubhaq, lepi shemmin hassetam haab mochel al kebodo libno. Abal talmid haokel lipne rabbo, apillu eno rabbo mubhaq — eno rashshay lehaseb bepanayv, mishshum mora ukebod harab, ella im ken natan lo harab reshut lehaseb bepanayv, sheaz chayyab hu lehaseb. Veen chiyyub al harab litten reshut letalmido lehaseb bepanayv, ella im rotzeh limchol al kebodo velitten lo reshut lehaseb — hareshut beyado. Veken haokel etzel talmid chakam muplag bedoro ap al pi shello lamad mimmennu kelum — chashub kerabbo, veen lo lehaseb bepanayv ad sheyyitten lo reshut. Vekol zeh kesheokel al shulchan echad im harab, abal im okel al shulchan acher — chayyab lehaseb, apillu hu rabbo mubhaq vegadol bedoro:

Vekol zeh betalmid shel tora, abal talmid hallomed ummanut, ap al pi shehu mityare merabbo umekabbedo umeshorto, ap al pi ken tzarik lehaseb apillu bepanayv. Veken abadim ushepachot haibrim tzerikin hasibba. Ap al pi shehen tzerikin lelek aneh vaana leshammesh basseuda, mikkol maqom bishat akilat kezayit matztza vaapiqoman ushetiyyat arba kosot shebbahen iqqar mitzvat hasibba kemo sheyyitbaer — epshar lahem lehaseb:
Kol mi sheppatur mehasibba umeseb — hare zeh niqra hedyot:

Ematay tzarik lehaseb? Bishat akilat kezayit shemmebarek alayv al akilat matztza, ubishat akilat hakkerika matztza umaror, ubishat akilat apiqoman, ubishat shetiyyat d' kosot, lepi shekkol debarim ellu hem zeker ligulla ulecherut, shehad' kosot tiqqenu chakamim keneged d' leshonot shel geulla haamurim beparasha vaera: "vehotzeti vegaalti velaqachti vehitztzalti", vehaapiqoman vehakkerika hem zeker lappesach, shehaya neekal derek cherut, lepikak hem tzerikin hasibba derek cherut. Abal shear kol hasseuda, im ratza leekol velishtot belo hasibba — hareshut beyado, veen beyadenu lehatzriko lehaseb. Abal mikkol maqom, hammeseb bekol hasseuda — hare zeh meshubbach veoseh mitzva min hammubchar:

Kol mi shetztzarik lehaseb veakal o shata belo hasibba — tzarik lachazor leekol velishtot bahasibba meiqqar haddin. Abal lepi sheyyesh omerim shebbizman hazzeh en tzarik lehaseb kelal bimdinot ellu — yesh lismok al dibrehem leinyan shebbediabad yatza belo hasibba. Umikkol maqom, leinyan akilat matztza — tob lehachamir lachazor veleekol bahasibba. Veken leinyan kos sheni, im shata belo hasibba — yachazor veyishteh bahasibba. Veen tzarik lachazor ulebarek "bore peri haggapen", ki birkat "bore peri haggapen" shebberak al kos sheni shehu samuk lasseuda hi poteret apillu hayyayin shebbetok hasseuda, kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"d. Abal im shata kos rishon o shelishi o rebii belo hasibba — en lo lachazor velishtoto bahasibba, lepi sheyyitztarek lachazor ulebarek alayv, shehare akshav en derek lishtot ben kos rishon lesheni, uben kos shelishi lirbii min haddin asur lo lishtot mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman ta"t, veken leachar kos rebii asur lishtot od kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tp"a, veim ken beshaa shebberak al kol kos mishshelosha kosot ellu belo hasibba veachar kak keshennizkar sheshshata belo hasibba verotzeh lachazor velishtot — hare zeh nimlak, vetzarik lachazor ulebarek, vihe nireh kemosip al minyan hakkosot shettiqqenu chakamim, laken tob yoter shello lachazor velishtot, velismok al haomerim shebbizman hazzeh en tzarik lehaseb kelal. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla tob sheyyihyeh bedato bitchillat hasibba qodem shemmebarek al kos rishon sheyyachazor veyishteh ben kos rishon lesheni al semak beraka zo, veaz apillu im yiteh veyishteh kos rishon belo hasibba — yukal lachazor velishtot belo beraka, velo yehe nireh kemosip al hakkosot, kevan shehu niptar bebirkat kos rishon, im ken hakkol shetiyya achat hi mupseqet lishnayim:

Tzarik lishtot had' kosot al hasseder sheyyitbaer, dehaynu shebben kos rishon lesheni uben shelishi lirbii yapsiq baamirat hahaggada vehahallel, uben sheni lishlishi yapsiq baakilat matztza ubirkat hammazon. Veim lo hipsiq benehem baddebarim hallalu, ella shata d' kosot zeh achar zeh — lo yatza yede d' kosot, ella kullan nechshabin lo lekos echad, vechayyab lishtot od [g'] kosot al hasseder sheyyitbaer:

Kol echad mid' kosot hallalu tzarik sheyyihyeh bo lo pachot merebiit yayin leachar sheyyimzegennu im hu yayin chazaq shetztzarik meziga, veshiur meziga hu lepi daat hashshoteh, kede shettihyeh shetiyya areba derek cherut. Veim shetao chay belo meziga, im yesh rebiit yayin bekol kos — yatza yede d' kosot, veen tzarik lachazor velishtot, abal yede cherut lo yatza, kelomar shello qiyyem mitzva min hammubchar. Usetam yenot shellanu enan chazaqim, veen tzarik meziga kelal:

Shiur hakkos shemmachaziq rebiit, orko kerochab b' gudalin, verochbo kerochab b' gudalin, vegobho kerochab b' gudalin vachatzi gudal vechomesh gudal. Veshiur zeh hu keshehakkos merubba al pene kol gobho, veal derek zeh teshaer bekos agol, shehaiggul pachot mimmerubba — rebia (shehu d' chumshin vachetzi), veim ken im hakkos hu b' gudalin orek ub' gudalin rochab — tzarik sheyyihyeh gobho g' gudalin veg' chumshe gudalin:

Yesh omerim shellekattechilla mitzva lishtot kol hakkos, apillu machaziq kamma rebiiyyot. Ap al pi shebbeqiddush shel shear yamim tobim veshabbatot apillu lekattechilla day bishtiyyat melo lugmayv, dehaynu rob rebiit, mikkol maqom bed' kosot shel pesach hechemiru chakamim lishtot kol hakkos lekattechilla. Ubediabad sheshshata rob hakkos — yatza. Abal im lo shata ella chatzi hakkos, apillu shechetzyo machaziq kamma rebiiyyot — lo yatza. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim sheap lekattechilla day bishtiyyat rob rebiit ap im hakkos machaziq kamma rebiiyyot. Veken iqqar, veken hamminhag pashut. Umikkol maqom, tob lachosh lassebara harishona veliqqach kos qatan velishtot kullo. Ubimqomot shehayyayin beyoqer — day bishtiyyat rubbo. Vekol zeh beg' kosot harishonim, abal bakkos haacharon — tzarik lishtot rebiit shalem, kede sheyyukal lebarek beraka haacharona beli shum piqpuq, kemo shennitbaer besiman q"tz leinyan kos birkat hammazon, ayyen sham:

Tzarik lizzaher lekattechilla lishtot rob harebiit bebat achat, dehaynu sheyyishteh oto bishtiyya achat velo yapsiqennu lishte shetiyyot. Velaken en liqqach kos sheppiv tzar keen sheqqorin (qlv"g gla"z), mippene shello yakol lishtot rebiit bebat achat. Ubediabad apillu hipsiq kamma peamim baemtza — yatza. Vehu shello yishheh mittechillat hashshetiyya ad sopah yoter mikkede akilat peras. Veyesh omerim shetztzarik shello yishheh mittechillat shetiyya rishona ad sop shetiyya acharona yoter mikkede shetiyyat rebiit (ayyen siman try"b). Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem leinyan shene kosot harishonim, sheim hipsiq kol kak beemtza hashshetiyya ad sheyyesh mittechillat hashshetiyya ad sopah yoter mikkede shetiyyat rebiit — tzarik lachazor velishtot oto hakkos belo beraka. Abal bishne kosot haacharonim, sheim yitztarek lachazor velishtot yehe nireh kemosip al minyan hakkosot kemo shennitbaer lemala — yesh lismok al sebara harishona, velo yachazor veyishteh ella im ken shaha mittechillat hashshetiyya ad sopah yoter mikkede akilat peras:

Mi sheeno shoteh yayin kol hashshana mippene shessoneo o shemmazziqo — ap al pi ken chayyab lidchoq et atzmo lishtot d' kosot, kemo sheameru chakamim al rabbi yehuda berabbi ileay shehaya shoteh arba kosot shel pesach veachar kak haya tzarik lachagor tzedaayv ad atzeret:

Abal qiddush shel shear yamim tobim veshabbatot — en tzarik lidchoq et atzmo lishtot hakkos, ella yakol lishmoa haqqiddush meacher, kemo shennitbaer besiman ar"b, mah sheen ken bearba kosot shel pesach, sheap bene habbayit shehen shomein haqqiddush vehahaggada mibbaal habbayit, ap al pi ken chayyab kol echad veechad lishtot d' kosot derek cherut:

Im i epshar lo laasot hasseder bitchillat hallayla miyyad vehattinoqot rotzim leekol, ap al pi shemmuttar litten lahem leekol qodem sheyyishmeu haqqiddush vehahaggada kemo shennitbaer besiman rs"t veta"a, mikkol maqom yemaher lesalleq hammaakal millipnehem velo yenichem leekol harbeh, shello yishnu bishat amirat hahaggada. (Veepshar shemmatztzat "lechem oni" asur lehaakilam apillu meat qodem amirat hahaggada, mittaam shennitbaer besiman ta"a, ayyen sham):

Veim hakkos sheshshata baal habbayit mimmennu hu gadol umachaziq kamma rebiiyyot — yekolin banayv ubene beto latzet bemah shennishtayyer bakkos mishshetiyyat baal habbayit, ubilbad sheyyaggia rob rebiit lekol echad veechad. Umikkol maqom mitzva min hammubchar litten kos lekol echad veechad bipne atzmo, kede shekkol echad yishteh mikkos male, shezzeh hiddur mitzva, kemo shennitbaer besiman qp"g:

Veap haqqetannim chayyab abihem lechannekam bemitzvot lehashqotam kosot al hasseder sheyyitbaer im kebar higgiu lechinnuk (dehaynu shehiggiu lazzeman sherauy lechannekam lishmoa haddebarim sheomerim al hakkosot, kegon shehen yodein meinyan qedushshat yom tob, velaken rauy lechannekam lishmoa haqqiddush sheomerim al kos rishon (ayyen siman rs"t). Vegam yesh bahen daat lehabin mah shemmesapperim lahem mitziat mitzrayim baamirat hahaggada, velaken rauy lechannekam lishmoa hahaggada sheomerim al kos sheni. Veken chayyab lechannekam lishmoa birkat hammazon sheomerim al kos shelishi, ugemar hahallel vehallel haggadol ve"nishmat" sheomerim al kos rebii). Veap haqqetannot shehiggiu lechinnuk dinam kiqtannim. Veken bishar kol hammitzvot hannohagot belayla zeh — en chilluq ben anashim lenashim, sheap shehannashim peturot mikkol mitzvot aseh shehazzeman gerama, ben shel tora ben shel dibre soperim, ap al pi ken chiyyebu otan chakamim bekol haddebarim shettiqqenu belayla zeh, lepi sheap hem hayu beoto hannes shel yetziat mitzrayim. Ubaakilat matztza hen chayyabot min hattora, lepi shehuqesha mitzvat aseh shel akilat matztza lemitzvat lo taaseh shel akilat chametz, shenneemar "lo tokal alayv chametz shibat yamim tokal alayv matztzot", lomar leka shekkeshem shehannashim muzharot al lo taaseh shel akilat chametz, shenneemar "ki kol okel machmetzet venikreta vego'", "ki kol" lerabbot hannashim — kak hen muzharot al mitzvat aseh shel akilat matztza:

Mitzva lachazor achar yayin adom im en hallaban meshubbach mimmennu, shenneemar "al tere yayin ki yitaddam", mashma shechashibuto shel yayin keshehu adom. Veap al pi shebbeqiddush shel shear yamim tobim veshabbatot nohagin kehaomerim sheen tzarik lachazor achar yayin adom im eno meshubbach min hallaban kemo shennitbaer besiman ar"b, mikkol maqom bed' kosot yesh linhog kehaomer shetztzarik lachazor acharayv, lepi sheyyesh bo zeker laddam, shehaya paroh shochet et bene yisrael. Veakshav shemmetzuyim laalol alilot sheqarim — nimneu milliqqach yayin adom lepesach:

Kol hayyenot hakkesherim leqiddush bishar yamim tobim veshabbatot kesherim learba kosot, kegon yayin mebushshal veqonedditon, dehaynu yayin shemmeorbin bo debash upilpelin. Vaapillu lekattechilla yakol latzet bahem im en lo yayin acher meshubbach kemotam, kemo shennitbaer besiman ar"b. Veken me sheriyyat tzimmuqim kesherim led' kosot im hem beinyan shekkesherim leqiddush, dehaynu sheyyotze mehen lachluchit qetzat al yede derika belo sheriyya bemayim. Ulepikak mi sheeno shoteh yayin mechamat neder — yiqqach me tzimmuqim learba kosot:

Veken bimqomot sheen yayin matzuy — mitzva min hammubchar liqqach me tzimmuqim. Abal meiqqar haddin bimqomot sheen yayin matzuy, dehaynu shemmahalak yom echad sebibot hair en gadel sham yayin harbeh ella meat mizzeer — yakol liqqach led' kosot shear mashqim shehem chamar medina beoto hair, kegon me debash bimqomot shergilin lishtoto bepesach veenan chosheshin leziyyup qemach, veal derek shennitbaer besiman ts"z. Veap al pi shebbeqiddush shel shear yamim tobim veshabbatot yoter tob leqaddesh al happat milleqaddesh al shear mashqim ap al pi shehu chamar medina kemo shennitbaer besiman ar"b, mikkol maqom belel pesach i epshar leqaddesh al happat, shehare chayyab bearba kosot, veharishon hu kos shel qiddush:

Vekol zeh beme debash vekayyotze bo mishshear mashqin hachashubim, shehare hem beoto hair bimqom yayin. Abal shear mashqin haggeruin, kegon me tappuchim (sheqqorin apy"l tran"q), ume zangebil sheqqorin (ayngb"r vvash"r), ume shoresh sheqqorin (laqry"tz), ap al pi sherob shetiyyat habbenonim beotah hair hi mimmashqim hallalu, mikkol maqom kevan sheenan mashqin chashubin — hare hen kemo mayim, sheap sherob shetiyyat hair hu mayim — en notelin otan lekos shel beraka, kemo shennitbaer besiman qp"b:

Apillu ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaqa veen lo maot liqnot yayin learba kosot, shello natenu lo haggabbaim — chayyab lilvot o limkor kesuto o lehaskir et atzmo bishbil yayin led' kosot o shear mashqim bemaqom shehem chamar medina. Veim en lo ella meat maot veim yiqneh bahen yayin led' kosot lo yihyeh lo ner bebeto — hare ner beto qodem led' kosot mippene shelom beto, veyaaseh hasseder al happat kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tp"g. (Veayyen sham din mi sheyyesh lo meat yayin veeno maspiq lo led' kosot lishne hallelot ek yaaseh):

Mitzva lechalleq lattinoqot qelayot veegozim belel pesach qodem asiyyat hasseder, kede sheyyiru shinnuy veyishalu: "mah nishtanna hallayla hazzeh mikkol hallelot". Veap al pi sheal sheela zo en lanu mah lehashib lahem, mikkol maqom al yede sheyyiru shinnuy zeh veyitoreru lishol alayv yitoreru gam ken lishol al shinnuyim acherim, dehaynu sheokelin matztza umaror veyoshebin bahasibba, veyashibu lahem: "abadim hayinu veku'":
